text:
maya: Quick UX sweep on Compliance > Data before shipping. Found three micro nits: encryption pill copy/affordance, retention unit ambiguity, and region select tab flow.
sam: share current strings/screens?
maya: badge reads 'Encrypted (KMS)'. tooltip: 'Data encrypted using customer-managed Key Management Service (KMS). Learn more about key rotation and access controls.' wraps badly on mobile.
rija: SR note: parentheses + acronym read awkwardly. Short visible label that reads naturally is better, e.g. 'Encrypted — customer key'. Put 'KMS' in the expanded doc/panel only.
oliver: contrast check: current green ~2.8:1. Need >=4.5:1. Proposal: darker fill #005f46 or light chip + dark text with 1px border. Also it's a <span> now  not focusable.
sam: plan: make the chip a <button> with aria-describedby pointing to a panel (id=kms-panel-189876). aria-label suggestion: 'Encryption: customer-managed key. Press Enter for details.'
maya: retention field shows numbers only (e.g., '90') and audit logs read 'Retention set to 90' which confused compliance. UI should display units inline ("90 days") and logs should say 'Retention set to 90 days'. Add optional 'reason' included in audit export.
rija: keyboard flow: visual order is Region then Retention, but DOM lands retention first. Found during keyboard walkthrough. Reorder DOM to match visual layout and add unit tests for tab order.
sam: I'll implement: 1) pill -> button with trimmed copy and darker color (#005f46); 2) bottom-sheet on mobile for panel; 3) retention shows unit suffix and audit message template updated; 4) reorder DOM for select + retention. Will include aria-label and visible focus ring.
qa-bot: Adding e2e checks: SR announces chip aria-label, contrast token check, tab order test, retention audit export includes 'days' and optional reason.
maya: timeline: small patch today -> PR -> staging. I'll review once deployed. :thumbsup:
